Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail

Class MailMessage

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail.MailMessage
public class MailMessage extends Object
A single e-mail message: the shared, Java 3D-free model both the 2D MailPanel and the native-3D Mail3D render, and the value object the MailService backend maps to and from the wire (Jakarta Mail).

A message is fetched in two stages. Listing a folder produces lightweight envelopes carrying the headers, flags and attachment metadata but no body (isBodyLoaded() is false); opening one fills the text / HTML body and the attachment bytes on demand. That split keeps a large folder fast to list and only pays for the payload the user actually reads.

getId() is the stable per-folder identifier the backend uses to re-find the message (the IMAP UID where the server offers one, else the message number). getFolder() and getAccountId() say where it lives so a triage action (move / delete / flag) can be routed back to the right account and folder.
